def: stillness; adverbially, silently; abstractly quiet, trust

occurrences.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
